verdict.rationale: Superset lets users delegate tasks from inside the app: the prompt-first flow launches an agent on a described task, Design and PR-diff selections can be sent to an agent, and there is in-app status tracking and diff review. However, the assistant is not built in. Superset orchestrates bring-your-own third-party CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Amp, etc.) rather than shipping its own assistant, and a user describes it as terminal-centric rather than chat-centric. Missing for 10: a first-party built-in AI assistant (not external CLI agents), a native in-product chat/assistant interface, independent hands-on corroboration of the delegation flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: In the prompt-first flow, describe the task, pick an agent, and create. The agent starts working on your prompt immediately.
Use **Design** in the browser pane to select an element and send your requested change to an agent with element context.
Open **Pull requests → Code**, select diff lines, and send feedback to a running or new agent session.
Any agent: Claude Code, Codex, Amp, Gemini, OpenCode, Cursor Agent, and more
